en: Sepia-toned postcard showing the entrance gate and guardhouse of an institutional complex surrounded by tall pine trees. Two men in light uniforms stand in front of a small tiled-roof gate building with an arched doorway. Behind the gate, a long multi-storey building with rows of windows and small domed roof structures is visible along a tree-lined driveway. The caption at the top reads "Coswig i. S. - Wettinstift". Additional small text appears on a vertical margin to the left and on plaques near the entrance.
